product_metadata.title: Yaufey 2500 Sq. Ft Home Dehumidifier for Medium to Large Rooms and Basements with Auto or Manual Drainage, 0.48 Gallon Water Tank Capacity - Low Noise and 24 Hr Timer
features: PROFESSIONAL & EFFICIENT DEHUMIDIFIER - Being able to remove up to 32.7 pints of moisture per day (Please note: under the condition of 95°F,90%RH, the max dehumidification capacity is up to 32.7 pints) . It is an energy-efficient dehumidifier which is ideal for basements, homes, bathrooms, bedrooms, garages, and other indoor spaces up to 2500 Sq. Ft.

CONVENIENT & SIMPLE TO USE - Home appliances need to be intuitive for easy use, and so is our home dehumidifier. It features an intelligent control panel, which lets you check its working status at a glance. Simply set your desired humidity, and the dehumidifier will continuously work until the water tank (0.48 Gallon) is full. Tired of manual drainage? It also comes with a drain hose (6.56ft) for hassle-free, continuous drainage.

MULTIPLE PRACTICAL FEATURES - You can switch the fan speed between regular and turbo levels for optimal comfort. The dehumidifier runs quietly to avoid disturbing you when you sleep or study. The removable, washable filter means easy maintenance — Simply clean it regularly for recycle use. Program the 24-hour timer to suit your lifestyle and save energy costs. These features together deliver the best possible dehumidification experience.

EASY MOBILITY AND TRANSPORT - Many mini dehumidifiers are portable while the dehumidification capacity is not impressive, and vice versa. Our home dehumidifier incorporates portability and performance. The smooth-gliding wheels and built-in handles make it easy for you to move the dehumidifier from one room to another. It ensures efficient moisture removal while being easy to transport just like many mini dehumidifiers. So awesome!

SUPPORT:All of Yaufey Dehumidifiers are covered with 30-Days Money Back if you are not satisfied with the product, 1 year warranty, 2nd year warranty extension and lifetime expert tech support. Please don't hesitate to contact us if there is any question, we will reply to you within 24 hours and help you solve the problems. Yaufey customer support team is always just one-email away.
